'''Chapter 134''' is titled "Dr. Kureha".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Side Issue: "[[Kaya]] Is Now A Doctor's Apprentice And Doing Fine"

True to her word, [[Kaya]] has begun pursuing her medical studies; though no longer "pirates" ''per se'', [[Tamanegi]], [[Ninjin]], and [[Piiman]] take it upon themselves to escort her through town every day.

==Short Summary==
[[Dalton]] reveals that [[Wapol]] was Drum Island's tyrannical king who abandoned his people during [[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]]'s attack, but is now returning to reclaim his throne. Meanwhile, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Sanji]] encounter hostile [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Lapahn|Lapahns]] while carrying a sick [[Nami]] up the mountain. Elsewhere, the eccentric [[Kureha|Dr. Kureha]] cures a dying boy and demands a steep payment.

==Long Summary==
Dalton is surprised to learn that the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] know about Wapol. Usopp responds that he tried to attack them a couple of days ago, and [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] reveals that she met him a while ago at the [[Levely]]. Vivi's comment prompts shock from Dalton as to her true identity. Vivi attempts to cover up her mistake and changes the subject. Dalton then explains that Wapol was the king of the country but fled when pirates arrived, which surprises Vivi as to how a king can be so uncaring towards his people.

Meanwhile, Luffy carries a feverish Nami through the snow, alongside Sanji. As they flee from the attack of a baby Lapahn, Luffy and Sanji trade absurd theories: Luffy claims to have heard in his [[Foosha Village#Partys Bar|village]]'s tavern that people in snowy countries do not sleep<ref name=":0">One Piece Manga and Anime — [[Volume 96|Vol. 96]] [[Chapter 966]] (p. 8) and [[Episode 966]], Buggy tells Shanks how he heard that Teach has never slept once in his life.</ref> because, if they fall asleep, they die. While dodging attacks from hostile Lapahn in the snow, Sanji argues that rubbing skin for warmth makes women's skin soft and pale. After Sanji easily dispatches a baby Lapahn, a pack of adult Lapahns appears to block their path.

Meanwhile, Wapol has finally found [[Sakura Kingdom|Drum Kingdom]]. At the same time, Dr. Kureha arrives at a tavern in a neighboring village to treat a young boy suffering from a fatal illness. Using her unorthodox medical expertise, she successfully cures him, but her aggressive demeanor and demand for an exorbitant fee shock his father and the local villagers. Despite their outrage, the recovered boy expresses his gratitude, and Kureha takes her payment before leaving.

*Vivi mentions a [[Levely|council of kings]] which she met Wapol at prior.
*[[Kureha|Dr. Kureha]] appears alongside an assisting reindeer known as [[Tony Tony Chopper]].
